about: Figure-QA ground truth. Authored from 200-dpi renders of the 30 mechanically-selected candidate pages in candidates.json, cross-checked against view/<id>.txt so that every question is answerable ONLY from the visual. Four-option multiple choice: short free-text answers were rejected because stray tokens in the extracted text (e.g. the bare letters 'C E B' on q03) would falsely credit the text-only arm on a string match. Random baseline is 25%.
authored_by: the same agent that runs the arms; see eval/figqa.md 'Limits of this measurement'

questions.q: In the 'Top View Pinout' package drawing, one terminal sits alone on one side of the package, opposite the other two. Which terminal is it?
questions.figure_only_because: the page text leaks the bare letters 'C E B' with no geometry; their arrangement exists only in the drawing

questions.q: In Figure 2, panel d shows a cross-section of the bare EMC chip. Which substrate is labelled in that panel?
questions.figure_only_because: the caption says 'with materials indicated' but never names the substrate; panel i is the Si one

questions.q: In Figure 7-1 (Load Circuit), what is the value of the load capacitance CL?
questions.figure_only_because: the whole page extracts to three lines; every waveform and circuit label is vector art

questions.q: In Figure 15 panel (a), what is the approximate MSE for n=700 at a clip multiplier of 1.0?
questions.figure_only_because: the caption lists the n values but no plotted magnitudes

questions.q: In the 'Effect of Sense Resistor Material on Temperature Performance' graph, at approximately what temperature do all three curves intersect at a normalised voltage of 1.0?
questions.figure_only_because: the prose describes the effect qualitatively; the crossing point is only readable off the plot

questions.q: In Figure 6 (Motor Control Circuitry), what gain is labelled on the current-sense amplifier feeding the comparator?
questions.figure_only_because: the page text is the section heading, one sentence and the caption

questions.figure_only_because: sub-captions extract but axis tick values do not
